learning_outcomes.text: Students will increase their business experience by closely familiarizing themselves with the working areas of the chemical engineering program and engaging in practices that reinforce the knowledge and skills acquired during their education.
Students will gain a sense of professional duty and responsibility.
Students will gain the ability to work in harmony with company personnel in a team and develop effective communication skills.
Students will recognize technological developments in their field and gain the ability to evaluate industrial applications, prepare and present reports.

syllabus_topics: The course content is created by the training personnel at the company and the responsible faculty member of the department, according to the student's activities within the scope of professional training at the company.
